newsitem.title: ITALY: Porn stars bare it all for Italian unity.
newsitem.headline: Porn stars bare it all for Italian unity.

text.p: Three porn stars launched a full frontal attack on the campaign for northern secession on Friday, with one of them baring all for unity outside Italy's national parliament.
Eva Henger, a blonde Hungarian-born stripper, paraded stark naked in body paint in the red, white and green of the Italian flag outside the lower Chamber of Deputies.
Two topless friends, Italian Lorena Ferrari and Brazilian Valentine Demy, held up a banner proclaiming "Nothing is more obscene that separatism".

The off-beat protest was staged to coincide with the start of three days of rallies by the separatist Northern League and its leader Umberto Bossi, who plans to proclaim a northern "republic of Padania" in Venice on Sunday.
The demonstration was cut short by smiling police, who stepped in to shield Henger from a posse of photographers and chaperone her from the elegant parliament to a waiting taxi.
A small group of bemused tourists watched the show.
"They're just like Bossi," said Roberto Turco, a visitor from southern Italy. "All they want is a bit of free publicity."
Italy's most famous political porn star, Cicciolina (Cuddles), was a member of parliament for the Radical Party from 1987 to 1992.
